inputReservation.verification: Matching official tokenizer JSON uses byte-level BPE with an empty normalization sequence and no prefix-space insertion. Text tokens are bounded by bytes; doubled here with explicit framing allowances. Official image limit is 1024 tokens per image. Any observed input-bound violation settles actual usage and pauses the provider globally.
